observations.capability_resolver: IL starts with servedCapabilityLookup undefined; the model module source then registers its callback. With no active/deactivated served catalog the attached callback returns undefined, so fy falls through to baked Hsr capability. A matching explicit CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL_CAPABILITIES=false is checked first and remains a veto.
observations.growthbook_roster: Gr asks k("tengu_loggia_roster", []). With the Native feature lookup source, disabled/no-readable-disk returns that fallback with source=disabled; enabled but no remote/disk value returns it with source=fallback. An explicitly readable cached value still wins with source=disk. An empty cold roster is not proof that no later refresh can load it.
observations.policy_service: C_ is a Native policy-service eligibility gate, not a cache-presence test. In the controlled helper execution, API-key auth and enterprise/team OAuth with the required scope enable it on the first-party route; missing auth, missing inference scope, prosumer OAuth, non-first-party provider and custom endpoint disable it.
observations.policy_cache: Native p4o begins with sessionCache=null, failOpenVerdict=false, and empty hintedDeniedKeys/hintedTaints. dS returns null when the service is disabled; when enabled and disk/session cache is absent it also returns null. sn denies allow_product_feedback for the enabled-service cache miss (metadata onCacheMiss=deny), but with the service unavailable and no local hints it returns allow. That is Native behavior, not a Host resolver-absence rule.
observations.feedback_env: Nre checks DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND, DISABLE_BUG_COMMAND and nonessential-traffic mode before dp(allow_product_feedback). The disable fields use JavaScript truthiness; strings "false" and "0" are truthy.
observations.model_route: When Native modelStringsCache is null, jS initializes its provider table from the baked provider-ID rows through ro(He()), then applies user modelOverrides. With the controlled empty-overrides first-party case, Gd chooses the baked opus5 alias and E9r resolves the candidate from that table; this is not a universal setting when Native model strings or user overrides are populated.
observations.host_boundary: Native Hsr/La still supplies static labels, family and capabilities in the absence of served catalog rows. The Rust ProviderApiAdapter snapshot resolver is optional and returns None if no embedding-host source is attached; that Host composition state is not equivalent to Native C_=false or Native missing policy cache.
